title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Nila goes to work while Chozhan pays off Pandian and Pallavan for privacy. Chandayatha admires Cheran driving to Hindi songs, and Vannathi reminds Pandian not to fight.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Pooja exposes her stepmother and uncle's scheme to claim the property in her name. Her stepmother and uncle make an emotional plea, urging her to return home with them.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Senthil tests Swetha to see if she has turned against Vennila after bonding with Kanmani. Maya and Iniyan surprise Kanmani and Anbu with a sand-and-clay family figurine.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Gomathi makes Thangamayil promise never to leave home under any circumstances. Meanwhile, Pandian angrily confronts Senthil after he admits to taking store money for personal use.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Vijaya struggles against the tempting aroma of Meena's cooking. Unaware she is fasting, Manoj brings home biryani, which the family enjoys while she continues to resist temptation.

title: Super Singer Junior
description: Super Singer's wildcard round brings comebacks, golden buzzers, and touching stories. A standout singer moves the judges to secure the fourth finalist spot.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Swetha is terrified when Karna appears in her dream in the middle of the night. Prabhakaran advises Vetri to win back Abinaya's love through sincere care and affection.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Kalamma celebrates Siddharth's unopposed election bid and causes public trouble. Paraman serves locals with water, winning Ilamathi's praise, who urges him to run.
